labels.label: That afternoon: they are to carry their researches into the inner apartment
That afternoon: they go on into Dr. Roylott's chamber

note: Proposed at ¶157; at ¶158 they are in the chamber.

label: That afternoon: Holmes walks slowly round Dr. Roylott's chamber, examining each thing in it
quote: Holmes walked slowly round and examined each and all of them

label: That afternoon: Holmes taps the safe and asks what is in it
quote: What’s in here?

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says it holds her stepfather's business papers
quote: My stepfather’s business papers

label: That afternoon: Holmes asks whether she has seen inside
quote: you have seen inside, then?

label: Some years ago: Miss Stoner once sees inside the safe, full of papers
quote: Only once, some years ago

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says she has seen inside only once
quote: I remember that it was full of papers

label: That afternoon: Holmes asks whether there is a cat in the safe
quote: There isn’t a cat in it, for example?

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner answers no, and calls it a strange idea
quote: What a strange idea!

label: That afternoon: Holmes takes up a small saucer of milk from the top of the safe
quote: He took up a small saucer of milk

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says they keep no cat, only a cheetah and a baboon
quote: we don’t keep a cat

label: That afternoon: Holmes remarks that a saucer of milk would not go far with a cheetah
quote: a cheetah is just a big cat

label: That afternoon: Holmes squats down and examines the seat of the wooden chair
quote: He squatted down in front of the wooden chair

label: That afternoon: Holmes rises, pockets his lens and says the point is settled
quote: That is quite settled

label: That afternoon: Holmes's eye is caught by a small dog lash on the bed, tied in a loop
quote: a small dog lash hung on one corner of the bed

label: That afternoon: Holmes asks Watson what he makes of the lash
quote: What do you make of that, Watson?

label: That afternoon: Watson says he does not know why it should be tied
quote: I don’t know why it should be tied

label: That afternoon: Holmes speaks of a clever man turned to crime and proposes to walk out upon the lawn
quote: it’s a wicked world

label: That afternoon: they turn from the chamber, Holmes grim and dark of brow
quote: when we turned from the scene of this investigation

label: That afternoon: they walk several times up and down the lawn, while Holmes is lost in thought
quote: We had walked several times up and down the lawn

label: That afternoon: Holmes tells Miss Stoner she must follow his advice in every respect
quote: you should absolutely follow my advice

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says she will do so
quote: I shall most certainly do so

label: That afternoon: Holmes tells her that her life may depend on it
quote: Your life may depend upon your compliance

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says she is in his hands
quote: I am in your hands

label: That afternoon: Holmes says that he and Watson must spend the night in her room
quote: both my friend and I must spend the night in your room

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner and Watson gaze at Holmes in astonishment
quote: gazed at him in astonishment

label: That afternoon: Holmes asks whether that is the village inn over there
quote: I believe that that is the village inn over there?

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says that it is the Crown
quote: that is the Crown

label: That afternoon: Holmes asks whether her windows would be visible from the inn
quote: Your windows would be visible from there?

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says they would
quote: Certainly.

label: That afternoon: Holmes tells Miss Stoner how she is to keep to her room, signal and withdraw
quote: You must confine yourself to your room

label: When her stepfather comes back: Miss Stoner is to keep to her room, on pretence of a headache
quote: on pretence of a headache, when your stepfather comes back
note: What Holmes tells her to do; it has not happened by the end of this scene.

label: To-night: Dr. Roylott is expected to retire for the night
quote: when you hear him retire for the night
note: Expected; it has not happened by the end of this scene.

label: To-night, once Dr. Roylott has retired: Miss Stoner is to open the shutters and undo the hasp
quote: you must open the shutters of your window, undo the hasp
note: What Holmes tells her to do; it has not happened by the end of this scene.

label: To-night: Miss Stoner is to put her lamp in the window as a signal
quote: put your lamp there as a signal to us
note: What Holmes tells her to do; it has not happened by the end of this scene.

label: To-night: Miss Stoner is to withdraw quietly into the room she used to occupy
quote: withdraw quietly with everything which you are likely to want
note: What Holmes tells her to do; it has not happened by the end of this scene.

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner says she can easily manage in her old room for one night
quote: Oh, yes, easily.

label: That afternoon: Holmes tells her to leave the rest in their hands
quote: The rest you will leave in our hands.

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner asks what they will do
quote: But what will you do?

label: That afternoon: Holmes says they will spend the night in her room and investigate the noise
quote: we shall investigate the cause of this noise

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner, her hand on Holmes's sleeve, says he has already made up his mind
quote: you have already made up your mind

label: That afternoon: Holmes says perhaps he has
quote: Perhaps I have.

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner begs him to tell her the cause of her sister's death
quote: tell me what was the cause of my sister’s death

label: That afternoon: Holmes says he would prefer clearer proofs before he speaks
quote: I should prefer to have clearer proofs

label: That afternoon: Miss Stoner asks whether her sister died from some sudden fright
quote: if she died from some sudden fright

label: That afternoon: Holmes says he thinks there was probably some more tangible cause
quote: some more tangible cause

label: That afternoon: Holmes says they must leave, bids Miss Stoner good-bye and tells her to be brave
quote: Good-bye, and be brave

label: That afternoon: Holmes and Watson are to leave, so that Dr. Roylott will not return and see them
quote: we must leave you
note: Their intention; the scene ends before they are told to go. Not ordered against Dr. Roylott's return, which is what they mean to avoid.

labels.label: To-night: Holmes and Watson must spend the night in Miss Stoner's room
To-night: Holmes and Watson are to spend the night in Miss Stoner's room and investigate the noise

label: To-night: Holmes and Watson must spend the night in Miss Stoner's room
quote: must spend the night in your room
note: Planned; it has not happened by the end of this scene. The lamp at ¶184 is the signal to them.
